title: Water board letter on housing for fire survivors
summary: On November 21, 2024, the chair deferred a draft letter of support to the state water commission, about water for temporary housing, to the next meeting without a vote so new members can give input. Testifiers urged prioritizing water for housing for displaced fire survivors, noting 87% were renters, while one suggested not sending the letter. A member argued against long-term commitments to permanent new construction until the water supply is known.

timeline.text: The board will discuss the draft letter at its next meeting.
Draft letter of support to the state water commission about water for temporary housing: The chair deferred the draft letter, with changes, to the next meeting without a vote.
The testifier suggested not sending the letter at all.
A testifier said 87% of the people displaced by the fire were renters.
A testifier urged the board to prioritize water for housing for displaced fire survivors.
A testifier said asking for a moratorium on new construction would be inappropriate.
He said his position is not opposition to development or construction.
The member argued against long-term commitments to permanent new construction until the water supply is known.
